name: OpenBudgets.eu
tagline: Upload, visualize, and analyse public budget and spending data to discover stories behind budgets
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
known_funders: European Union Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme
news_articles: OpenBudgets.eu: Making Public Spending Transparent (European Commission, 2015)
How Open Data is Changing Budget Transparency in Europe (Open Knowledge Foundation, 2016)
academic_citations: Zuiderwijk, A., & Janssen, M. (2014). Open data policies, their implementation and the demand for enhanced user support. Journal of Organizational Computing and Electronic Commerce, 24(2-3), 256-275.

Charalabidis, Y., Loukis, E., & Androutsopoulou, A. (2016). Fostering innovation in the public sector through open data. In Proceedings of the 49th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (pp. 2262-2271).
awards: Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation Action Grant (2014-2017)
policy_outcomes: Increased transparency in EU budget allocation
Enhanced public access to spending data across member states
published_performance_metrics: User engagement metrics and data upload statistics available on project website
documented_limitations: Data quality varies by member state
Limited adoption in some Eastern European countries
failure_modes: Limited integration with national budget systems
curation_criteria: Data must be in standardized format (OBEU schema); peer review by project team
contributor_governance: Managed by core team; community contributions through GitHub
government_partnerships: Various EU member state statistical offices

scraped.scraped_description: Upload, Visualize, Analyse public budget and spending data. Start exploring and learn stories behind budgets.
